newsitem.title: GREECE: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - JULY 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - JULY 7.

text.p: Leading stories in the Greek general press:

--Forest fires plagued the country over the weekend, with the most serious being the one just outside Thessaloniki in the Seih-Sou forest. The city was plunged into darkness after an electricity plant was damaged by the flames, with six explosions alarming residents of the northeastern suburbs.
--Greek teenagers are pro-democracy and liberty but ethnocentric, according to a new international survey of the beliefs and ambitions of the world's teenagers.

--The state's fire-fighting capabilities were sorely tried over the weekend, with special airplanes delayed three hours before they could work on the catastrophic Seih-Sou fire. The fire just outside Greece's second largest city is now considered to be the biggest environmental catastrophe in recent years.
--A new housing development programme being drafted by the environment, town planning and public works ministry the issue of bond loans to raise funds from the private sector.
--The state-run lottery organisation OPAP is planning to introduce new games as of November. The new games are hoped to raise another 200 billion drachmas in revenues.
